notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market product org (SaaS CRM-adjacent) exploring Redwood for customer-facing conversational UI + doc search. Initial interest started with Hosted API — rapid prototyping succeeded, now moving to Dedicated POC for predictable latency and data isolation.

POC scope (agreed on call 2026-03-02):
- 4-week Dedicated POC in us-west-2 (customer preference) with VPC peering and KMS-managed keys. SE will provision a small reserved GPU pool + burst nodes.
- Canary deployment plan: route 5% of production-like traffic to Redwood Dedicated variant (model v1 int8) for 3 days, evaluate latency, tokens/sec, and quality metrics. If successful, increase to 25% then 100%.
- Fallback routing: primary route -> dedicated-us-west (model v1 int8); fallback -> hosted-us-east (model v1 float16) then hosted-eu (model v1 float16) as last resort. Failover target: < 2s additional latency vs baseline.
- Rollback policy: automated rollback if inference error-rate > 1.5% OR median tail latency (p95) increases > 30% vs baseline for 6-hour window. Manual approval required for config changes that alter model variants or routing thresholds.

Requirements & priorities (from product + infra):
- Latency SLO: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for chat completions under 256 tokens.
- Throughput target: sustained 120 reqs/sec with 12k token/minute overall.
- Cost sensitivity: want clear committed capacity pricing and example unit economics; interested in Optimize recommendations (batching and KV prefix cache).
- Model preferences: open-model family with ability to pin quantized variant; want automatic fallback to higher-capacity hosted model on overload.
- Security: SSO (SAML), per-request audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, KMS for key management, retention controls (30/90 day options), and data residency guardrails.

Quote from PM: "We need deterministic latency during peak demo weekends — can't have noisy cold-starts affecting demos."

Open items / blockers:
- Legal needs clarification on cross-region fallback and contractual residency guarantees (SEC-4498).
- SE assigned to provide sample committed capacity ARRs and run cost model for 120 reqs/sec profile (asked by 2026-03-15).
- Need written SLA for canary failover window and expected recovery times.

Artifacts: pricing deck + POC plan in Drive (see links). Fireflies transcripts for kickoff + POC planning attached. Jira INF-4321 opened for initial infra quota request.
